facts.fact: In 2021, 72% of Americans (218.4M) were listening to digital audio monthly, according to the page.
facts.quote: In 2021, 72% of Americans (218.4M) were listening to digital audio monthly, and that number is expected to grow.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen Media Lab, audio ads have a 24% higher recall rate than traditional display ads.
facts.quote: According to [Nielsen Media Lab](https://digiday.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2017/02/ThePowerOfAudio_collated_v3.pdf), they have a 24% higher recall rate than traditional display ads.

facts.fact: Audio ads are usually either 15 or 30 seconds long.
facts.quote: Audio ads are usually either 15 or 30 seconds long.

facts.fact: For a 15-second audio ad, the vendor recommends a script length of about 40 words.
facts.quote: For a 15 second ad, aim for a script length of 40 words.

facts.fact: For a 30-second audio ad, the vendor recommends a script length of 55-75 words.
facts.quote: For 30 second ads, aim for 55-75 words.

facts.fact: The brand name should be repeated 2-3 times throughout an audio ad, per the author's guidance.
facts.quote: the brand name should be repeated 2-3 times throughout the ad.

facts.fact: Audio ad files exported for programmatic delivery should be 500MB or smaller.
facts.quote: Make sure the file is 500MB or smaller (the smaller the better!).

facts.fact: Accepted audio ad export formats listed are OGG, MP3, MP4, WAV, FLAC, or AAC.
facts.value: OGG, MP3, MP4, WAV, FLAC, AAC
facts.quote: it’s exported in the format OGG, MP3, MP4, WAV, FLAC, or AAC.

facts.fact: The author says StackAdapt reporting for audio campaigns shows cost per completed listen, audio completion rate, absolute completes, and quartile completions.
facts.quote: Within StackAdapt, I’m able to see the cost per completed listen, the audio completion rate as well the absolute completes, quartile completions (to help understand if and when users dropped off) and more.

facts.fact: The author says StackAdapt lets advertisers connect audio campaigns with attribution partners such as comScore or Upwave.
facts.quote: connect your campaign with a leading attribution partner like comScore or Upwave can give you a sense of how your one channel contributed to the entire customer journey.

facts.fact: The author states that StackAdapt offers 1st- and 3rd-party targeting, custom audience capabilities, and contextual targeting as an alternative to behavioural targeting.
facts.quote: A DSP that has 1st- and 3rd-party targeting options, custom audience capabilities, and offers an alternative to behavioural targeting, like contextual targeting, is what I use most

facts.fact: The author advises starting audio campaigns broad and narrowing by geography or demographics over time, and avoiding demo targeting on specific deals.
facts.quote: it’s best to start broad and slowly narrow in on your audience, whether that’s from a geo perspective, or demo.
